scholarship_title: University of Verona International Master's Scholarships and Reduced Fees 2026/2027
provider_organization: University of Verona (Università degli Studi di Verona)
degree_fields: Languages for Global Business, Trade and Tourism
eligible_nationalities: All (non-Italian citizens with a foreign degree, not resident in Italy)

financial_coverage.tuition_coverage: Scholarship winners: full fee exemption (pay only EUR 205 regional tax and stamp duty). Separately, 48 non-EU students get a reduced flat fee of EUR 1,000 per year for two years.

stipend.notes: Two years. Paid in two instalments of EUR 4,000 per year. Year 2 requires 40 credits by 30 Sep 2027. 16 scholarships in total (one or two per programme); cannot be combined with Italian regional (DSU/ESU) grants.

additional_benefits: Housing (priority consideration for an ESU residence place)
International Welcome Desk support (residence permit, bank account, tax code, health insurance)

application_fee.notes: Pre-admission fee; deducted from later fees for students who enrol (except scholarship winners).

eligibility_criteria.min_gpa: Varies by programme from 70% to 85% of the maximum (e.g. AI 85%, Data Science 80%, Computer Engineering 75%)
language_proficiency: English B2 or previous degree taught in English
C1 in two languages for the language programmes

country_specific_notes.note: Duolingo is not accepted (only for applicants from Iran and Afghanistan). A degree taught in English can replace the English certificate.

required_documents: Bachelor's degree certificate (or enrolment certificate with expected completion date)
Receipt for the EUR 50 pre-admission fee
preparation_alerts: Winners must accept within 7 days of the ranking and apply for a Type D study visa
Diploma translation and legalisation plus Declaration of Value (or CIMEA statements) needed to enrol
Visa proof of funds: at least EUR 546 per month

verification_status.verification_notes: Read directly from the official call. The call's title says 15 scholarships but its Article 1 and the table total 16; recorded as 16. The application portal (unicandidate.com) is the one named in the university's own call. Previously excluded under the old fee rule; the EUR 50 fee is paid to the university and is not a scam signal.
